name: 化学专业英语词汇
description: 化学核心必备词汇，共 225 词

words.translation: n. 原子；微量，极小量
words.example: Neutrons and protons are bound together in the nucleus of an atom.
words.exampleTranslation: 在一个原子的核内，中子和质子聚合在一起。

words.translation: n. 分子，摩尔；少量，一点儿；微小颗粒，微粒
words.example: The DNA molecule is compounded from many smaller molecules.
words.exampleTranslation: 脱氧核糖核酸分子是由许多更小的分子组成的。

words.translation: n. 反应，回应；反应能力（reactions）；（药物或食物引起的）不良反应；化学反应；反作用力；（对旧观念等的）抗拒；反动，守旧
words.example: Reaction to the visit is mixed.
words.exampleTranslation: 对这次访问的反应不一。

words.translation: n. （化学）催化剂；诱因，诱导者
words.example: Many policy makers insist that consumer spending is a strong economic catalyst and, therefore, a paucity of retail stores is a contributing factor to low-performing economies.
words.exampleTranslation: 许多政策制定者坚持认为，消费者支出是一个强大的经济催化剂，因此，零售商店稀缺是经济表现不佳的一个促成因素。

words.translation: n. 同位素
words.example: As an indicator of shifts in the Earth's climate, the isotope record has two advantages.
words.exampleTranslation: 作为地球气候变化的指标，同位素记录有两个优势。

words.translation: adj. 共价的；共有原子价的
words.example: These three components are interwoven, and direct covalent linkages.
words.exampleTranslation: 这三种成分相互交织，直接形成共价键。

words.translation: adj. 离子的；电价的；爱奥尼亚柱式的（古希腊建筑风格，有涡卷饰）；n. 爱奥尼亚语；【印】一种粗字面铅字
words.example: The ion-supported hypervalent iodine(iii) reagent is a kind of "task-specific ionic liquids".
words.exampleTranslation: 离子负载的高价碘（iii）试剂是一种“功能化离子液体”。

words.translation: n. [化学] 氧化
words.example: Chemoautotrophs and chemoheterotrophs obtain energy from inorganic oxidation reactions.
words.exampleTranslation: 化学自养生物和化学异养生物从无机氧化反应获得能量。

words.translation: n. 减小，降低；减价，折扣；（照片、地图、图片等的）缩图，缩版；归纳，简化；（数学）归约，约化；染色体减半；简编曲（管弦乐改编的钢琴曲或小乐队演奏曲）；浓汤，浓汁；脱臼（或断骨）复位；（化学）还原，被还原；（语音）弱化
words.example: There has been some reduction in unemployment.
words.exampleTranslation: 失业人数有所减少。

words.translation: n. 酸；<非正式>迷幻药；尖刻（或尖酸）的言语（或语调）；质子供体，电子对受体；adj. 酸的；酸性的；尖酸的，刻薄的；（颜色）刺目的，鲜亮的；（岩石，尤指熔岩）含相当量硅石的
words.example: Rye is tolerant of poor, acid soils.
words.exampleTranslation: 黑麦耐贫瘠的酸性土壤。

words.translation: n. 根基，底部；基础；基地；基础成分；（数字进位制中的）基数；（棒球）垒；碱，盐基；（晶体管的）基极；词根；v. 以……为基础；把基地设在……；adj. 卑鄙的，下流的；低劣的；【名】 （Base）（英、美、爱尔兰）马濑（人名）
words.example: He's gone AWOL from his base.
words.exampleTranslation: 他从基地开了小差。

words.translation: n. （化学）滴定，滴定法
words.example: In Dr Nersesian’s titration the litmus was a species called the brushtail possum.
words.exampleTranslation: 涅尔谢相博士的滴定实验中的“石蕊指示剂”是一种叫帚尾袋貂的动物。

words.translation: n. [高分子]聚合物；n. （Polymer）人名；（英）波利默
words.example: The nature of the polymer is currently a trade secret.
words.exampleTranslation: 该聚合物的属性目前是个行业秘密。

words.translation: n. [化学] 同分异构物；[核] 同质异能素
words.example: It is a constitutional isomer of dimethyl ether.
words.exampleTranslation: 这是二甲醚的结构异构体。

words.translation: n. [化学] 电负性；[化学] 电负度
words.example: The affection on the enthalpies of formation aroused by factors, such as size factor, electronegativity, the energy of orbit of selectron etc, is also discussed.
words.exampleTranslation: 还讨论了尺寸因子，电负性，选择子的轨道能量等因素对形成焓的影响。

words.translation: n. 化学计量学
words.example: We will cover stoichiometry and solution chemistry this semester.
words.exampleTranslation: 本学期下半学期我们将涵盖化学计量学和溶液化。

words.translation: v. 黏合；建立关系；把（货物）存入关栈中（bond 的现在分词）；n. 人与人之间的关系；键合；粘合
words.example: Brick works in high-temperature furnaces, maybe tiles on the shuttle, to resist high temperatures because of the high internal bonding.
words.exampleTranslation: 砖在高温熔炉中工作，比如航天飞机上的贴的砖，因其强内部键可以抵抗高温。

words.translation: adj. 含金属的，金属制的；（金属碰撞发出的）叮当声的；（色彩）似金属的，像金属般闪烁的；金属味的；尖利刺耳的，难听的；n. 金属制品，含金属物；金属色泽
words.example: There was a metallic click and the gates swung open.
words.exampleTranslation: 一声金属碰撞的咔嗒声后，大门打开了。

words.translation: n. [有化] 碳氢化合物
words.example: These reactions increase the probability of incomplete combustion and are more likely to release uncombusted and photochemically active hydrocarbon compounds into the atmosphere.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些反应增加了不完全燃烧的可能性，更有可能释放未燃尽和光化学活性碳氢化合物到大气中。

words.translation: n. [有化] 链烷；烷属烃
words.example: That means each of its molecules contains an oxygen atom as well as the carbon and hydrogen found in an alkane.
words.exampleTranslation: 就是说每个分子也都含有氧原子以及在烷烃中存在的碳和氢。

words.translation: n. [有化] 烯烃；链烯烃
words.example: Diastereoselective transfer of the diazene hydrogen to one face of the prochiral alkene was studied.
words.exampleTranslation: 研究了重氮烯氢向前手性烯烃单侧的非对映选择性转移。

words.translation: n. 炔属烃
words.example: Introduction to the Alkyne Triple Bond.
words.exampleTranslation: 炔烃三键介绍。

words.translation: adj. 芳香的，芬芳的；芳香族的；n. 芳香植物；芳香剂
words.example: Technically speaking, a spice is part of an aromatic plant that is not a leaf or herb.
words.exampleTranslation: 从技术上讲，香料是芳香植物的一部分，不只是叶子或药草。

words.translation: n. 含酒精饮品，酒；酒精，乙醇；醇
words.example: Wine contains about 10% alcohol.
words.exampleTranslation: 葡萄酒含有约10%的酒精。

words.translation: n. 乙醚；[有化] 以太；苍天；天空醚
words.example: Her words disappeared into the ether.
words.exampleTranslation: 她的话消失在九霄云外。

words.translation: n. 醛；乙醛
words.example: An aldehyde is an organic compound containing a formyl group.
words.exampleTranslation: 醛是一种含有甲酰组的有机化合物。

words.translation: n. 酮
words.example: Methanethiol, furanthiol, pyrazine, trans, trans-2,4-nonadienal and furfuran ketone were used to develop beef flavor.
words.exampleTranslation: 采用甲硫醇、呋喃硫醇、吡嗪、反-2，4-壬二烯醛和呋喃酮等主要的牛肉香气成分香原料，可以调配出香气逼真的炖牛肉香精。

words.translation: adj. [有化] 羧基的
words.example: Carboxylic acid esters are important chemical raw materials.
words.exampleTranslation: 羧酸酯是重要的化工原料。

words.translation: n. [有化]酯；n. （Ester）人名；（法）埃斯泰；（德、西、意、葡、罗、挪、丹、芬、爱沙）埃斯特尔
words.example: The invention relates to the application of elaidic acid ethyl ester.
words.exampleTranslation: 本发明涉及到反油酸乙酯的应用。

words.translation: n. [有化]胺（等于 amin）；n. （Amine）人名；（阿拉伯）阿明；（俄）阿米涅
words.example: The chiral HMPA analogues were prepared in high yield by nucleophilic substitution between the chiral secondary amine and phosphoryl chloride.
words.exampleTranslation: 通过磷酰氯与手性仲胺的亲核取代反应高产率地合成了手性 HMPA 类似物。

words.translation: n. 氨基化合物；酰胺
words.example: The effect of content of water on the yield of 2-phenylbenzmide by using sodium amide was studied.
words.exampleTranslation: 研究了水分含量对氨基化钠制备2-苯基苯甲酸胺收率的影响。

words.translation: n. 蛋白质，朊；adj. 蛋白质的
words.example: You need more protein to build you up.
words.exampleTranslation: 你需要更多蛋白质以增强体质。

words.translation: n. 碳水化合物，糖类；含碳水化合物的食物，糖类食物；含碳水化合物的食物，糖类食物
words.example: Protein and carbohydrate have 4 calories per gram, per unit weight.
words.exampleTranslation: 每克每单位重量蛋白质和碳水化合物产生4卡路里。

words.translation: n. 脂质；油脂
words.example: MsbA is a lipid flippase.
words.exampleTranslation: MsbA是一种脂质反转酶。

words.translation: adj. 核的
words.example: Biochemists call it the central dogma: Genetic material, in the form of a long nucleic acid polymer called DNA, stores a digital record of every protein's design.
words.exampleTranslation: 生物化学家将这套系统称之为中心法则(central dogma)：以长链核酸聚合物形式存在的DNA是遗传物质，它储存着每种蛋白质设计的数据记录。

words.translation: n. 酶
words.example: This enzyme would make the filtration of beer easier.
words.exampleTranslation: 这种酶会使啤酒更容易过滤

words.translation: n. 培养基，基质，基层；底物，酶作用物；（供放置或刻的）底面
words.example: Adults of this species burrow deeply into the substrate where it is cooler and perhaps moister.
words.exampleTranslation: 这个物种的成虫深入到底层中，那里更凉爽，也许也更湿润。

words.translation: n. [助剂] 抑制剂，抗化剂；抑制者
words.example: Inhibitor drugs have been developed to block two of the proteins, to slow progression of the disease after infection.
words.exampleTranslation: 已经开发出抑制药物来阻断其中两种蛋白质，以减缓感染后疾病的进程。

words.translation: n. 反应动力学；动力学；运动学
words.example: Thermal Decomposition reaction kinetics of cerium carbonate was investigated with Netzsch thermal analyzer.
words.exampleTranslation: 利用德国耐驰综合热分析仪对碳酸铈分解过程动力学进行了研究。

words.translation: n. 平衡，均衡；（心情的）平静，心理平衡；（经济）（供求的）平衡；（化）平衡；能量均分
words.example: We have achieved an equilibrium in the economy.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们已在经济上达到平衡。

words.translation: n. [热] 焓；[热] 热函；热含量
words.example: Something I can measure and I can tabulate, and when I turn my dT knob, I know what's going to happen to the enthalpy.
words.exampleTranslation: 我可以测量它并制成表格，当我转动 dT 旋钮，我就知道焓的变化了。

words.translation: n. [热] 熵（热力学函数）
words.example: If we calculate the change in entropy during gas mixing, we will find that this quantity is positive.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果我们计算气体混合过程中熵的变化，我们会发现这个量是正的。

words.translation: n. 吉布斯（姓氏）
words.example: Gibbs was arrested in the early hours of yesterday morning.
words.exampleTranslation: 吉布斯在昨天凌晨被捕。

words.translation: n. [热] 量热学；热量测定
words.example: All right, let me just go through one numerical example of a calorimetry calculation, OK.
words.exampleTranslation: 好，让我们来做一个量热，法计算的例子，我不会把所有的。

words.translation: n. 溶解度；可解决性
words.example: The results showed that he solubility of xylitolincreased with adding impurities such as sorbitol or adonitol.
words.exampleTranslation: 结果表明，木糖醇的溶解度随加入山梨糖醇或山梨糖醇等杂质而增加。

words.translation: n. 专心，专注；关注，重视；集中，聚集；含量，浓度
words.example: Tiredness affects your powers of concentration.
words.exampleTranslation: 疲劳影响注意力的集中。

words.translation: n. [化学] 摩尔浓度；容模
words.example: These two solutions still contain exactly the same number of molecules because they are of the same molarity.
words.exampleTranslation: 这两种溶液仍然含有相同数量的分子，因为它们的克分子浓度相同。

words.translation: n. 质量摩尔浓度 [分化] 重量摩尔浓度 [化学]（旧称重量克分子浓度）
words.example: I said we're going to use molality.
words.exampleTranslation: 刚才说我们要用质量摩尔浓度。

words.translation: n. 常态；[化学] 当量浓度；[化学] 规定浓度
words.example: A semblance of normality has returned with people going to work and shops reopening.
words.exampleTranslation: 随着人们上班、商店重新营业，表面已恢复了常态。

words.translation: adj. （尤指公司）有偿付能力的，付得起的；有溶解力的；n. 溶剂；（对处境的某种态度）起削弱（或瓦解）作用的事物；解决方法
words.example: Lead is more solvent in acidic water.
words.exampleTranslation: 铅在酸性水中更易溶解。

words.translation: n. 溶质，溶解物；adj. 溶解的
words.example: So now the CS2 is the solute.
words.exampleTranslation: 那么CS2就是溶质。

words.translation: n. （问题、困难等的）解决办法；（练习或竞赛的）解答，答案；溶液；溶解过程，溶解状态；（满足特定需要的）产品（或服务）（solutions）
words.example: Do you have a better solution?
words.exampleTranslation: 你有更好的解决办法吗？

words.translation: adj. 胶质的，胶体的；n. 胶状体
words.example: Colloid tumour pretty is troublesome.
words.exampleTranslation: 胶质瘤蛮麻烦的。

words.translation: n. 暂停，中止；暂令停职（或停学、停赛等）；（车辆的）悬架，减震装置；悬浮液，悬胶体；（乐）延留音
words.example: The car's improved suspension gives you a smoother ride.
words.exampleTranslation: 汽车悬架经过改进，乘坐起来更平稳。

words.translation: v. <正式>使……突然降临，加速（坏事的发生）；使突然陷入（某种状态）（precipitate sb./sth. into）；（使）沉淀，（使）淀析；<正式>使急落直下，使陡然下落；降水（如雨、雪、冰雹）；adj. <正式>鲁莽的，仓促的（=precipitous）；（事件，情况）突如其来的，突然的；猛地落下的；n. 沉淀物，析出物
words.example: I don't think we should make precipitate decisions.
words.exampleTranslation: 我认为我们不应该做出仓促的决定。

words.translation: n. 滤液；滤气；v. 过滤；筛选
words.example: A filtrate collection box sits underneath, and seals against, the upper belt.
words.exampleTranslation: 滤液收集盒紧靠着上方皮带的下面密封。

words.translation: n. 精馏，蒸馏，净化；蒸馏法；精华，蒸馏物
words.example: The Arabs are usually accredited with the discovery of distillation.
words.exampleTranslation: 通常认为，阿拉伯人发明了蒸馏法。

words.translation: n. 色层分析；色谱分析法

words.exampleTranslation: 用高效液相色谱法测定尿中尿碱含量。

words.translation: n. [光] 光谱学
words.example: The element was found using X-ray spectroscopy.
words.exampleTranslation: 这种元素是利用 X 射线光谱学发现的。

words.translation: adj. 核子的，原子核的；核武器的；原子能的，核能的；核心的，中心的；细胞核的，构成细胞核的
words.example: Nuclear power is cleaner than coal.
words.exampleTranslation: 核能比煤更清洁。

words.translation: adj. 轨道的；<英>（公路）环城的；眼眶的；n. <英>外环高速公路；（物理）轨道电子密度
words.example: In molecular orbital theory, we named orbits based on their symmetry.
words.exampleTranslation: 在分子轨道理论中，我们基于轨道的对称性给它们命名。

words.translation: n. 电子
words.example: Magnetic coils focus the electron beams into fine spots.
words.exampleTranslation: 磁线圈将电子束聚焦成细小的点。

words.translation: n. [物]质子；n. （Proton）人名；（法）普罗东
words.example: Every time you had one more proton, you had another element.
words.exampleTranslation: 每发现多一个质子，就会多一种元素。

words.translation: n. 中子
words.example: If the conditions are right, they will combine, fuse and form darmstadtium plus neutron.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果条件合适，它们将结合、聚变，形成鐽中子。

words.translation: n. （化）正离子，阳离子；【名】  （Cation）凯申（人名）； （Cation）（英）凯申（人名）

words.exampleTranslation: 2-降冰片基阳离子已经由多种降冰片烷衍生物和试剂制成。

words.translation: n. 阴离子，负离子
words.example: The mechanism of organic acids on an anion exchange column Shim pack (Shimadzu, Japan) have been studied.
words.exampleTranslation: 研究了有机酸在阴离子交换柱垫片组（日本岛津）上的作用机制。

words.translation: n. 电解液，电解质；电解

words.exampleTranslation: 质子交换膜燃料电池采用全氟磺酸固体聚合物膜为电解质。

words.translation: adj. 电流的；使人震惊的；触电似的
words.example: This corrosion is also galvanic.
words.exampleTranslation: 这种腐蚀也是电池腐蚀。

words.translation: n. [化学] 电解，[化学] 电解作用；以电针除痣
words.example: Faraday conducted electrolysis of silver.
words.exampleTranslation: 法拉第做了银的电解实验。

words.exampleTranslation: 电池充电时，能量从阴极移至阳极。

words.translation: n. [化学]价；[化学]原子价；[化学]化合价；效价；n. （Valence）人名；（法）瓦朗斯

words.translation: n. 八重奏，八重唱；八行诗；八个一组的物品；[计] 八位字节

words.exampleTranslation: 而octet数组却不会。

words.translation: n. [晶体] 晶格；格子；格架；vt. 使成格子状
words.example: We were crawling along the narrow steel lattice of the bridge.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们沿着大桥窄窄的钢制格子爬行着。

words.translation: adj. 无定形的；无组织的；[物] 非晶形的
words.example: These are amorphous targets.
words.exampleTranslation: 这些都是无形的目标。

words.translation: adj. 透明的；水晶般的；水晶制的
words.example: There have been so much solid crystalline salt beneath the floor of the Mediterranean.
words.exampleTranslation: 在地中海的海底下曾经有那么多的固态结晶盐。

words.translation: n. [物化] 同素异形体
words.example: Naturally occurring transparent, colorless crystalline allotrope of carbon.
words.exampleTranslation: 天然存在的透明、无色、结晶的碳的同素异形体。
